decision.explanation: The sources explicitly state Navneet Kumar Upadhyay attended Shoolini University (D1S4, D1S11), completed his undergraduate degree at the University of Delhi (D2S5), attended Ege University as an exchange student (D2S6), and completed primary education at Delhi Public School (D2S5). The Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi is mentioned as a place where he 'joined... as a research fellow' (D2S12), which implies employment rather than attendance as a student, so it is excluded based on the specific relation 'attend'. All other institutions are directly supported by the text as places of attendance.
